title: Session placement
summary: A test machine is a QA host reached only through its lease; it is never a launch target. When a Yoke QA mission installs Yoke on a test machine and connects it, that connect registers a Machine with the server it reached, hosted or self-hosted. The walker finds it with `yoke machine list` on that server, launches onto it through that same server with `--machine MACHINE_ID`. Fresh-host reset retires the Machine named by the lab user's saved identity through its saved connection before wiping. Walkers still clean up test projects and repositories as docs/testing-verification/qa-fixture-cleanup.md teaches. Inherit cases keep the Machine until reset.
